invariants.rationale: The method uses tmjFile as an argument; typically, a FileHandle parameter is expected to be non-null.
The method operates on tileSet, and downstream use (such as parsing or extracting fields) typically assumes non-null JsonValue.
If tmjFile is provided for asset loading, it is often expected that it refers to an existing file.
A JsonValue instance is typically either an object, array, or value—this covers standard JSON node types.
